chapter.title: Photons to Purpose
chapter.sub: Light speaks before a word is said.

items.alt: Three fixtures cross their beams on the stage: warm key from one side, cool fill from the other, a pink back light from above.
narration: Key light. Fill light. Back light. Three lights, one feeling.

items.alt: A top-view diagram: the subject in the middle, a key light at 45 degrees, a fill light opposite, a back light behind. Maya explains.

bubbles.text: We're not decorating. We're directing attention.

items.text: FIELD NOTE —  Color temperature and the key–fill–back triangle are the fastest tools for shaping mood, on any budget.
